title: Incentives are for losers
summary: This article challenges the conventional business wisdom that monetary incentives are the primary driver of performance and success, arguing instead that intrinsic motivation and genuine passion often produce better outcomes than purely incentive-based approaches.
problem_solved: Addresses the over-reliance on financial incentives as a management and decision-making tool, which can backfire or create unintended consequences.
why_valuable: It offers a contrarian perspective that encourages readers to think critically about common business axioms and consider the limitations of purely extrinsic motivation strategies.
